name: pinvou3-app
description: pinvou3 智能助手桌面应用（Tauri 2.0 + DeepSeek-TUI + Qwen3.6）

scripts.lint:ui: eslint src/main.jsx src/components src/features src/hooks src/shared
scripts.prebuild:nsis: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/prepare-windows-runtimes.ps1 && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/clean-nsis-staging.ps1
scripts.build:nsis:stage: npm run prebuild:nsis && tauri build --features dev-tools --no-bundle && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/stage-windows-nsis-resources.ps1
scripts.bundle:nsis: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/stage-windows-nsis-resources.ps1 -ValidateOnly && tauri bundle --features dev-tools --bundles nsis --config src-tauri/target/release/nsis-stage/tauri.nsis-stage.conf.json
scripts.test: npm run test:update-notice && npm run test:scheduled
